subject: Speed vs billboards and superjumps
author: Xandu
body:
According to The Burnout Team you can actually do all the Super Jumps and Billboards in the slowest car in the game.

-- The Creator --

subject: last smash and superjump
author: ZombieTron
body:
I have been on my last smash and superjump for a while, not that I've been obsessively looking, but I definatly want to get them all!

The billboards are the easiest to get, as you can't miss them! the only hard bit is working out how to get to them and then being in a fast enough car to make the jump.

--- The Original and the Best ---

subject: Toally
author: Flamechu
body: I'm an achievement whore, so of course. The billboards aren't that hard. You're more than likely to get them all by just driving around and doing online challenges. The smashes are a bit harder. The last two drove me crazy, and they were hidden in the quary.

subject: Yes
author: Mad Wookiee11
body:
The car you get for the smashes is the Carbon GT concept, which is by far the most durable speed car on the game.  I would also try to finish the billboards (some of which you will find along with smashes) because you get the Carbon Hawker, which is in my opinion the best all around car in the game.  Have you found all of the smashes and billboards along the train tracks?  That might cover a lot of it if you haven't.  I found most of my last smashes just driving around in areas I didn't normaly go.
